CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE AS TO "ALLEN GOODWIN, PRESIDENT REPUBLIC INDEMNITY" BY COURT AT SMALL CLAIM HEARING OF APR-20-2016 AT 1:30 PM.

MOTION FOR TRANSFER IS GRANTED. "ALLEN GOODWIN, PRESIDENT REPUBLIC INDEMNITY" IS DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE; REPUBLIC INDEMNITY APPEARED AND PARTIES AGREED TO ADD AS A DEFENDANT. SMALL CLAIMS ACTION TRANSFERRED IN TO SUP ST CASE CGC 16-551185. REPUBLIC INDEMNITY WAIVED DEFICIENCY IN SERVICE, PLAINTIFF CLARIFIED SUING REPUBLIC INDEMNITY; REPUBLIC INDEMNITY MADE MOTION TO TRANSFER. PLAINTIFF APPEARED, REPRESENTED BY GARY HELD. DEFENDANT REPUBLIC INDEMINTY APPEARED, REPRESENTED BY FERDINAND MANANSALA. ALLEN GOODWIN DID NOT APPEAR. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: JOANNE MADDEN. CLERK: J. BERTELSEN. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SC-105A ORDER ON REQUEST FOR COURT ORDER (SMALL CLAIMS) IS GRANTED. FILED BY DEFENDANT REPUBLIC INDEMNITY
